title: Bounded process probes
responsibility: Runs a limited number of timed system-tool probes and returns process facts or canonical executable paths; failed or cancelled probes produce unknown results.

inputs.name: processProbes.limits
inputs.description: Optional limits applied to each system-tool call created by this probe interface. `timeoutMs` sets the per-call timeout and defaults to `probeMs` (3000 ms); `signal` cancels running calls and prevents queued calls from starting, with at most eight calls running at once across this module.

outputs.name: processProbes
outputs.description: Provides `ran` for a tool's success flag and stdout, `facts` for parsed process facts, and `executable` for a process's canonical executable path. Calls use a configurable timeout (3000 ms by default), a 16,000,000-byte maximum buffer, and at most eight concurrent slots; `ran` turns tool failures into `ok: false`, while `facts` and `executable` return `null` when data cannot be read or parsed.
